approach-widen-the-scope-so-the-records-.reason: It reverses a decision taken one change earlier for a reason that has not changed. `src/generated/` and `dist/` are regenerated from the canonical contract and never hand-edited, so a finding in them cannot be acted on where it is reported. It would also put generated output under the gate's new-code conditions, so regenerating the contract would red a required context on code no reviewer can edit.

approach-assert-the-known-unresolved-cou.reason: It pins a hand-maintained number, which is the defect shape this repository has recorded four times, and the number moves for legitimate reasons: it went from 2 to 4 when #452 added the Node binding's report, with nothing wrong. A contributor facing a failing assertion whose correct response is usually to update the number will update the number. It also leaves the analyser being handed coverage for components it was told not to index, so the two artefacts still disagree.

approach-filter-with-a-hard-coded-exclus.reason: It creates a sixth copy of the scope and makes the failure quieter than the warning it replaces. Two lists that must agree — the exclusions the analyser reads and the prefixes the filter strips — will diverge, and when they do the filter drops records the analyser would have indexed, silently removing real coverage. Filtering without an existence check turns a moved file from a louder warning into no signal at all.
